history_json.frame: The same night wildfire from the same helicopter altitude, several hundred metres up, looking steeply down: inside the burning pine forest a colossal clearing in the exact shape of the interlocking YSL monogram has been cut into the forest floor. The monogram is hundreds of metres tall and fills most of the frame; each bare-earth stroke is wider than a four-lane road, edged by a low line of fire, with tall unburnt forest canopy pressing in around it and smoke drifting across parts of it. The trees are tiny from this height. Dozens of models walk the strokes in ordered single-file lines; each is a tiny figure no bigger than a grain of rice, far smaller than a tree crown.
